recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Only revisit if Pharmacy or workflow makes a new decision to restore an onBehalfOf concept to MedicationAdministration performer.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy issue requesting that MedicationAdministration.onbehalfof be part of the MedicationAdministration.performer backbone instead of being a top-level element.
initial_application: FHIR-12387 first introduced a top-level MedicationAdministration.onBehalfOf while adding the performer backbone. Commit 6aceb453fc5da56a92144d6de12c118e3b891ef0 then applied FHIR-12631 by changing MedicationAdministration.onBehalfOf to MedicationAdministration.performer.onBehalfOf in the spreadsheet source.
additional_context: FHIR-14022 later aligned MedicationAdministration to the updated Workflow Event pattern; commit b22fbdaff11417e468a75c0657ffec6170e99c1f removed performer.onBehalfOf while retaining performer.function and performer.actor. MedicationAdministration is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current active StructureDefinition has no onBehalfOf element to relocate. Zulip and Confluence searches found only bot/commit references and no substantive conflicting rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing performer.onBehalfOf for FHIR-12631 would conflict with the later applied FHIR-14022 workflow alignment.

related_jiras.note: Introduced the MedicationAdministration performer backbone and initially placed onBehalfOf at top level, creating the condition corrected by FHIR-12631.
Later workflow-alignment decision removed MedicationAdministration.performer.onBehalfOf from the current resource shape.
Duplicate QA issue about the wording of performer.onBehalfOf on medication resources; it did not change the structural decision for FHIR-12631.
